desc:
Drop into FORTRUSH—an endless Zone Wars battle where the action never stops!

The most realistic recreation of "Fortnite" on Roblox.

🔫 Spawn with randomized weapons and consumables.
🏗️ Build, edit, and battle your way through Cedar Grove.
🌀 Stay ahead of the moving storm.
🪂 Get eliminated? Return from the sky and jump straight back in!
🎮 Play on PC, mobile, or console.

The storm resets. The fight continues.

Formerly Known As Blox Fort

🚧 FORTRUSH is in early access. Expect updates, improvements, and occasional bugs!
